authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts despite high visual fidelity in textures. The text on the clock faces is nonsensical gibberish (e.g., '12.200 113 AHTL'), failing to render legible numbers or brand names. Structurally, the pig's front legs merge unnaturally into the gap between the clock panels, lacking defined paws or hooves and appearing melted into the background. The animal pose auditor flagged a HIGH artifact risk with 72% low-confidence keypoints, confirming widespread anatomical uncertainty. While the lighting and materials are convincing, these structural and semantic defects reduce authenticity.
